name: Occlusion-Aware Radiometric Derivatives in Media
aliases: Piecewise linear radiance approximation in media
Second-Order Occlusion-Aware Volumetric Radiance Caching derivatives
definition: A method formulating radiance at x as a piecewise linear representation of incoming radiance by building an approximated coarse representation of the scene as seen from the media point x via triangulation of adjacent stochastic angular samples.
summary: Occlusion-Aware Radiometric Derivatives in Media computes radiance derivatives for participating media using concentric triangulations that model visibility changes via geometry terms, unifying surface and volumetric light transport.
